summary: Claude CLI output capture fails because: (1) mem_buf silently dropped at EOF when output is under spool threshold (64KB), (2) receive_events only reads spool file or truncated 2KB preview, (3) planner_invocations table never populated — insert_invocation() defined but never called.

root_causes.title: mem_buf silently dropped in run_sink at EOF
root_causes.description: When using CapturePolicy::Spool with output under max_memory_bytes threshold (64KB), data is buffered in mem_buf (line 142). At EOF (after while loop), mem_buf is dropped — it's never flushed to spool file or included in StreamCaptureResult. Only the 2048-byte preview is accessible. If Claude's output is between 2KB and 64KB (typical for real prompts), the 'result' event at the end of the stream is lost.
root_causes.fix: At EOF, if mem_buf is non-empty and no spool file exists, create spool file and flush mem_buf to it. This ensures spool_ref is always Some when output > 0 bytes.

root_causes.title: receive_events only reads spool file or preview
root_causes.description: ClaudeCliSession::receive_events() first checks outcome.stdout_ref (spool file path), else falls back to outcome.stdout_preview (2048 bytes max). Since RC-1 causes spool_ref to be None for small outputs, only the preview is available — which is truncated to 2048 bytes and may not contain the final 'result' event.
root_causes.fix: After RC-1 fix, spool_ref is always set for non-empty output. The existing fallback logic is correct but depends on RC-1.

root_causes.title: planner_invocations table never populated
root_causes.description: GoalRepo::insert_invocation() is defined (repo.rs:710) but never called. ProductionGoalPlanner::call_adapter() only records in-memory RoleInvocation structs. The planner_invocations table (migration 028) remains empty, making durable invocation counting impossible. Same issue in ProductionGoalEvaluator.
root_causes.fix: Added SqlitePool to Planner/Evaluator constructors. call_adapter now INSERTs a 'running' record BEFORE spawn and UPDATEs to 'completed'/'failed' on completion.

root_causes.title: Spool threshold too high for typical LLM output
root_causes.description: max_memory_bytes is set to 64KB. Typical Claude CLI output for a single-turn prompt is 5-15KB, well under the threshold. Without RC-1 fix, this means NO spool file is ever created for normal planner/evaluator invocations.
root_causes.fix: RC-1 fix makes this moot — data is flushed to spool regardless of threshold breach.

capture_tests.key_test: test_small_output_creates_spool_at_eof — PASS (proves EOF flush fix works)

fixes_applied: capture.rs: Added EOF mem_buf→spool flush (lines after while loop)
claude/mod.rs: No changes needed — existing spool_ref→preview fallback correct
planner.rs: Added pool field, durable INSERT before spawn, UPDATE on completion
evaluator.rs: Same durable invocation lifecycle as planner
production_graph.rs: Pass pool to Planner/Evaluator constructors
remaining_investigation: If 0 bytes are still captured after fixes, investigate CREATE_SUSPENDED + .cmd file interaction with tokio::process. The raw CLI test via System.Diagnostics.Process (no CREATE_SUSPENDED) captures 8536 bytes correctly.
